Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: CRED's rewards spin - a yellow Spin button fires a slot-machine blur of gems, then a bouncy winning-ticket reveal with confetti and a staggered recap.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A dark rewards screen: a purple banner ("up to Rs 5,000"), a field of gem slots (colored gem icons in a loose grid), a bright yellow Spin button, and a coin balance at top. Winning reveals a "you won" banner with a green ticket card and a cashback recap.

## Motion spec
Pattern: slot-machine spin with reward reveal.
- Tap Spin: the button compresses (scaleY 0.9, spring back ~500/22) and the gem grid starts cycling - icons swap rapidly (every 60ms) with vertical motion blur, columns slightly desynced (left column 20ms ahead).
- Spin decays over ~1.8s: swap interval eases from 60ms to 300ms until the grid lands on the final set, each landed gem popping (scale 1.2 to 1, spring ~480/20, center-outward 30ms stagger).
- Win reveal: a green ticket card launches from the grid center (translate up with rotation -10deg to 0, spring ~320/18) while confetti shards burst behind it (~24 pieces, gravity-affected, 900ms); "you won" and the reward text ("flat Rs 200 off...") slam in word by word (scale 1.4 to 1, 150ms each, 60ms stagger).
- Recap: the screen dims and the reward summary rows stagger up (translateY 20px, 200ms, 80ms apart) ending with the cashback amount ticking up to its value (400ms).
- Spin button dims and disables during the spin, re-arms with a shine sweep (300ms) when the recap closes.

## Calibration
- The spin must feel weighty: at least 1.5s of cycling before decay.
- Confetti is behind the ticket, never over the reward text.

## Reduced motion
Gems crossfade to the result; ticket fades in without confetti.

## Don't miss
- Yellow is reserved for Spin; the win ticket is green; the banner stays purple.
- The gem grid is loose and organic, not a strict 3-reel slot.
